abstract: Maintains micro-meteorological stability modeling clearances, scheduled surveillance runtimes, and anemometer telemetry
system_message:
You are the Atmospheric dispersion specialist (MET). Your business responsibilities include maintaining micro-meteorological stability modeling clearances, scheduled surveillance runtimes, and anemometer telemetry for industrial chemical leak forensic investigation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains micro-meteorological stability modeling clearances, scheduled surveillance runtimes, and anemometer telemetry（DISP）
information_points.content:
MET-DISP-588：For the Grid-based stationary optical sensing and soil core extraction plan, micro-meteorological boundary layer clearance is true within the proposed plume sampling elevation window, and the planned field surveillance duration is 40 h across the active forensic plume screening phase.
MET-DISP-O9F：For the Autonomous aerial spectrometry and plume dispersion transect plan, micro-meteorological boundary layer clearance is false within the proposed plume sampling elevation window, while the planned field surveillance duration is scheduled at 80 h for the active forensic plume screening phase.
MET-DISP-9L6：For the Mobile laboratory drive-by sniffing and effluent tracer injection plan, micro-meteorological boundary layer clearance is true within the proposed plume sampling elevation window, and the planned field surveillance duration is 80 h during the active forensic plume screening phase.

information_points.title: Anemometer mast calibration（ANEM）
information_points.content:
MET-ANEM-LT8：For the Mobile laboratory drive-by sniffing and effluent tracer injection plan, the ultrasonic anemometer measurement elevation for the portable perimeter weather station array is 10 m above ground level.
MET-ANEM-4FR：For the Grid-based stationary optical sensing and soil core extraction plan, the ultrasonic anemometer measurement elevation for the portable perimeter weather station array is 25 m above ground level.
MET-ANEM-ERT：For the Autonomous aerial spectrometry and plume dispersion transect plan, the ultrasonic anemometer measurement elevation for the portable perimeter weather station array is 40 m above ground level.
